case_title: PHYU PHYU AUNG VS. DERWIN KIRKLAND

docket_entries.description: AUTO ACCIDENT CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $6,728.19 FILED BY AUNG, PHYU PHYU AS TO DEFENDANT KIRKLAND, DERWIN ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR NOV-17-2020 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506

REQUEST TO WAIVE COURT FEES AND COSTS PURSUANT TO G.C. 68633, CRC 3.51, 8.26, AND 8.818 (CONFIDENTIAL) FILED BY PLAINTIFF AUNG, PHYU PHYU ORDER FOR WAIVER OF COURT FEES AND COSTS GRANTED PURSUANT TO G.C. 68634 (E), CRC 3.52
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED SEP-12-2020, SUBSTITUTE SERVICE ON NATURAL PERSON AS TO DEFENDANT KIRKLAND, DERWIN

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF NOV-17-2020 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF NOV-17-2020 BY PANG LY. PLAINTIFF PHYU PHYU AUNG IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT DERWIN KRIKLAND IS NOT PRESENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. COMMISSIONER: PANG LY; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-17-2020 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF AUNG, PHYU PHYU RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT KIRKLAND, DERWIN $6,728.19 PRINCIPAL, TOTAL JUDGMENT $6,728.19, DEFENDANT WAS IMPERMISSIBLY ON THE ISLAND AT 7TH AND BRANNAN WHERE PLAINTIFF WAS IN THE RIGHT TURNING LANE WAITING FOR THE LIGHT TO MAKE A RIGHT TURN. BASED ON THE TESTIMONY, PHOTOGRAPHS AND DOCUMENTS, PLAINTIFF ESTABLISHED THAT DEFENDANT WAS THE DRIVER WHO CAUSED THE ACCIDENT. DEFENDANT TO PAY THE COURT $50.00 AS PLAINTIFF WAS GRANTED A FEE WAIVER. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
